evals.prompt: Do a systematic review of the evidence on four-day workweek trials and productivity. I need a pre-registered protocol, explicit inclusion and exclusion criteria, and a PRISMA flow I can defend in review.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Writes the protocol — question, inclusion and exclusion criteria, exact search strings per database — before searching; Reports the PRISMA 2020 flow with counts that reconcile at every stage; Logs every full-text exclusion against a single reason and shows the exclusion table; Grades each included study for risk of bias and source reliability before synthesis.
expectations: Writes the protocol — question, inclusion and exclusion criteria, exact search strings per database — before searching
Reports the PRISMA 2020 flow with counts that reconcile at every stage
Logs every full-text exclusion against a single reason and shows the exclusion table
Grades each included study for risk of bias and source reliability before synthesis

evals.prompt: What does the published research actually say about remote work and developer productivity? I want a reproducible survey of the literature, not a web summary — someone else should be able to re-run the search and get the same papers.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Treats reproducibility as the requirement: exact queries with dates run, and a documented screening procedure; Screens in duplicate and reports an inter-rater agreement statistic; Distinguishes convergent findings, divergent findings with their methodological cause, and gaps.
expectations: Treats reproducibility as the requirement: exact queries with dates run, and a documented screening procedure
Screens in duplicate and reports an inter-rater agreement statistic
Distinguishes convergent findings, divergent findings with their methodological cause, and gaps

evals.prompt: We need the full evidence base on this intervention for a peer-reviewed paper. Screen the search results against our criteria, record why each full text was excluded, and give me the flow diagram counts.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Applies the identification, screening, eligibility and inclusion stages in order; Produces the flow counts and validates the arithmetic with scripts/prisma.py flow; Keeps the excluded-studies list with reasons as part of the deliverable.
expectations: Applies the identification, screening, eligibility and inclusion stages in order
Produces the flow counts and validates the arithmetic with scripts/prisma.py flow
Keeps the excluded-studies list with reasons as part of the deliverable

evals.prompt: I already have twelve comparable trials with odds ratios and confidence intervals. Pool them into one overall effect size and tell me how heterogeneous they are.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Pools the effect sizes with fixed-effect and random-effects estimators and reports I² and tau²; Does not re-run search and screening (meta-analysis behaviour).
expectations: Pools the effect sizes with fixed-effect and random-effects estimators and reports I² and tau²
Does not re-run search and screening (meta-analysis behaviour)

evals.prompt: What year was the transformer architecture first published, and by whom? Give me a sourced answer.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Answers the single factual question with a verified source; Does not launch a protocol-driven multi-stage review (grounded-answer behaviour).
expectations: Answers the single factual question with a verified source
Does not launch a protocol-driven multi-stage review (grounded-answer behaviour)
